title: Resolution urging Albany to expand Fair Fares to commuter rail
summary: This resolution calls on the State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation requiring a 50 percent fare discount for Fair Fares-eligible New Yorkers and those earning up to 200 percent of the federal poverty level on the Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North, paratransit and city subways and buses. It would also require the MTA, working with the City, to run a public outreach campaign to boost Fair Fares enrollment. Fair Fares currently serves about 379,000 enrollees, while an estimated 450,000 more New Yorkers could become eligible under the expanded income threshold.
